title: Farewell to Ziyue
summary: Ye Fan's Mother Qi manifests as armour and he turns on the black-robed man who hunted Ziyue, who is ready to die to claim the Ancient Holy Body for his Master; a flashback shows the man being recruited by that Master, who wants special physiques like Ziyue's and Ye Fan's. Ye Fan survives by a thread and then, speaking of Hua Yunfei's zither, makes clear he sees Hua Yunfei's hand in the attacks; Hua Yunfei lets him go with a 'we'll meet again'. Ziyue says Ji Hui will stop hunting him for her sake and begs to travel north with him, and he agrees, but he then leaves her behind, reasoning that he isn't of this world and the Ji family is the safest place for her. Hua Yunfei tells Ji Hui everything he did was for her and argues that Ye Fan's cauldron and Holy Body could one day shake the world, but she rebukes him for deciding on her behalf. At a Domain Gate town, a Xiaoyao Sect notice announces a Ji family bounty of 1,000 catties of source on Ye Fan, blamed for killing Ji Supreme Elder Ji Changkong in a great fire, and gate fees have risen to Source Stones. A 'doctor' who trades artifacts for Source Stones sets up a robbery by the Four Xiaoyao Immortals, whom Ye Fan beats, but in the gate queue the now-bearded Ye Fan is recognised and mobbed by bounty hunters.
